question: Two right-angled triangles, PQR and STU, have their hypotenuses PR and SU equal. If the sides PQ and ST are also equal, the triangles are congruent by which mathematical rule?
solution:
**Given:**

Two right-angled triangles, PQR and STU

Hypotenuses PR and SU are equal

Sides PQ and ST are equal

**Formula Used:**

RHS Congruence Rule: If the hypotenuse and one side of two right-angled triangles are equal, the triangles are congruent.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496bd3d44442349352beaa3099a0e246a17e0340dca55a2dcaa4c18969f7fc16.png] 

⇒ Hypotenuse PR = SU

⇒ Side PQ = ST

⇒ Triangles PQR and STU are congruent by RHS rule

**∴ The correct answer is RHS.**
